title: Crew: A tiny crew of monsters for your Claude Code agents | Product Hunt
excerpt: Crew gives every Claude Code chat and subagent a body: a little pixel monster that walks along the bottom of your screen, digs while it works, sleeps when it's idle, and waves when it's done. Free for macOS. Nothing ever leaves your Mac.
